title.narrative: Civil Society for Inclusiveness, Democracy and Human Rights
Civilsamhälle för inkludering, demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter

description.narrative:
1) MR-organisationer stärker sina finansiella, tekniska och organisationella kapaciteter för att bättra kunna främja mänskliga rättigheter i Palestina.
2) MR-organisationer är mer proaktiva och responsiva in deras främjande av mänskliga rättigheter, jämställdhet, transparens och ansvarighet.

1) Human Rights Civil Society Organizations have strengthened financial, technical and organizational capacities to better advocate for Palestinian human rights.
2) Human Rights Civil Society Organizations are jointly more proactive and responsive in their promotion of human rights, gender equality and transparency & accountability.

Output 1: Human Rights Civil Society Organizations have strengthened financial, technical and organizational capacities to better advocate for Palestinian human rights.
Output 2: Human Rights Civil Society Organizations are jointly more proactive and responsive in their promotion of human rights, gender equality and transparency & accountability

During 2025, Civil society organisations strengthened human rights protection through a combination of strategic litigation, legal assistance, documentation, research, policy advocacy and public engagement. Their work challenged restrictions affecting humanitarian access and freedom of movement, documented patterns of human rights violations, and generated evidence to support legal action, advocacy and accountability efforts.
Across the reporting period, organisations produced research, policy papers, legal submissions, reports and testimonies that informed engagement with national authorities, international institutions and foreign governments. Evidence collected through field documentation and legal casework supported advocacy on systemic human rights concerns, while coordinated engagement with policymakers, humanitarian actors and civil society strengthened the visibility and consistency of advocacy messages.
Documentation and analysis reached wide international audiences through global media coverage and contributed to public debate on humanitarian and human rights issues. Organisations also delivered educational and public outreach activities that strengthened longer-term awareness and engagement.
Through collaboration in national and international coordination mechanisms and civil society coalitions, these organisations reinforced collective advocacy on humanitarian access, accountability and the protection of human rights. Overall, they helped sustain independent monitoring, evidence-based advocacy and legal action during a period of increasing restrictions on civic space.
